sources.entry: GopherSRE - Blog Posts about Go and SRE.

summary.name: GopherSRE
summary.one_liner: A personal blog by an SRE writing about Golang, DevOps and related topics, with posts on securing admin traffic, the webgear web-components package, Flatbuffers, JSON encoding and Unix domain socket IPC packages.
use_cases: Securing administrative or diagnostic endpoints on services
Building web UIs with Go and web components
Choosing a serialization format for Go
Doing inter-process communication on Linux or macOS in Go
Learning Go for SRE and DevOps work
summary.what_it_does: The page is the index of a personal blog about Go, DevOps and SRE. The visible excerpts cover securing administrative traffic between hosts, the author's webgear package for building web pages in Go with web components, and a look at Flatbuffers compared with Protocol Buffers and JSON. Other posts discuss the slowness of the standard library JSON encoder and BSON as an alternative. The last excerpt introduces a set of Go packages for Unix domain socket IPC on Linux and macOS, adding authentication, chunking, message streaming and RPC.
notable: Author wrote the webgear package for building web UIs with Go and Web Components
Unix domain socket packages add authentication, chunking, streaming and RPC on top of net.Dial/net.Listen
Posts evaluate Flatbuffers and JSON/BSON encoding performance in Go
caveats: Unix socket packages are stated to target Linux and OSX systems only
Page text is excerpts from blog posts; no full articles or license information shown
